display_long_description:
DeoVR Hyper is a dedicated video streaming platform and VR video player for high-quality, immersive viewing on your headset. Use it as your main place to discover and watch VR videos, from short clips to long-form cinematic experiences.

🎬 Immersive VR streaming

Stream VR 180 and 360 videos with smooth, stable playback that feels like a private VR cinema. DeoVR Hyper is tuned to keep you inside the scene.

📽️ Support for modern VR video formats

Watch mono and stereo content across flat. This app is built for today’s VR video standards so creators can publish confidently and viewers always get the intended experience.

🕶️ Passthrough and comfortable viewing

Blend virtual video with your real room using passthrough for a more natural way to watch VR content. Adjust projection, scale and viewing angle to match your space and comfort preferences.

🎛️ Focused, intuitive interface

Navigate your library, pick a video and start watching in just a few clicks. The interface stays minimal and consistent so you can focus on the content, whether you are watching a quick clip or a full feature.

🔮 Future-ready VR video platform

The app is evolving with new capabilities, including local playback for videos stored on your headset, volumetric content you can move around in, and Build Your Own Journey (BYOJ) for interactive, branching video experiences.

Download DeoVR Hyper and turn your headset into a dedicated home for premium VR video streaming.

This release is a beta version.
